revision.description: Bumped by the core on every applied operation; stale direct edits are rejected.

muted.description: True: the track plays no sound in export and preview, whatever its clips' (or angles' and mics') own `audio`. Default false.

hidden.description: Video tracks only. True: the track shows no picture in export and preview (the tracks below show through); its sound still plays. Default false.

behind.description: Video tracks only (ADR 0032): id of a video track listed before this one (lower in the stack), the plate. This track's pictures go behind the person in front on the plate: while this track shows a clip, the plate's media clips are drawn again above it through their subject matte, so a word or a logo sits between the background and the person. A shown track between the plate and this one covers the person: while it shows a clip, nothing is drawn again. Absent: none.

id.description: Stable, core-generated (`c_…`); reference clips by it.

start.description: Timeline seconds of the first frame.

scriptRef.description: Script scene this clip realizes: `scripts/<file>.md#<anchor>`; without `#anchor`, the whole script.

take.description: Shoot take this clip was placed from by `shoot.assemble` (ADR 0023); re-assembly replaces only clips that carry a take of its shoot.

x.description: Horizontal offset in project pixels from the centered position. Default 0.

y.description: Vertical offset in project pixels from the centered position. Default 0.

gain.description: Gain in dB; 0 = unchanged, negative = quieter. Default 0.

effects.description: Audio effects applied in order (at most 8), e.g. the voice chain highpass, denoise, compressor. Baked once per asset and chain into `.frameshell/audio-fx/`; export and preview play the bake.

frequency.description: Cutoff in Hz: rumble below it is removed, 10 to 1000. Default 85.

oneOf.description: High-pass filter: removes rumble and handling noise below `frequency`.

floor.description: Noise floor in dB, -80 to -20. Default -30.

reduction.description: Noise reduction in dB, 0.01 to 97. Default 8.

oneOf.description: FFT noise reduction of steady background noise (hiss, hum, room tone).

threshold.description: Level in dB above which the sound is compressed, -60 to 0. Default -20.

makeup.description: Gain in dB added after compression, 0 to 36. Default 2.

oneOf.description: Compressor: evens out loud and quiet passages.

dissolve.description: Seconds: mix from the clip that ends where this one starts, centered on the cut (a crossfade for sound). Short material shortens it; with no clip butted before, it plays as a fade in.

kind.description: `wipe`: a straight edge crosses the frame and uncovers the incoming clip. `push`: the incoming clip slides in and pushes the outgoing one out.

direction.description: Way the incoming picture travels: `left` (default: it enters from the right edge), `right`, `up` (enters from the bottom) or `down`.

shape.description: Shape of this clip's `dissolve` instead of a mix (needs `dissolve`); plays on the bottom video track only. Sound still crossfades.

fadeIn.description: Seconds: fade in from black (transparent on upper tracks; silence for sound) at the clip's start.

fadeOut.description: Seconds: fade out to black (transparent on upper tracks; silence for sound) at the clip's end.

x.description: Keys of this property (project pixels), sorted by `at`; held before the first and after the last. Replaces the static value.

at.description: Clip-clock second of the key: the seconds the clip's `in` counts (source, composition or nested-timeline seconds).

ease.description: How the value moves from this key to the next: `linear` (default), `in` (slow start), `out` (slow end), `in-out`.

auto.description: Set by the command that wrote this key (`duck`: `track.duck`). Running that command again replaces keys with this mark and keeps the others; setting or moving a key by hand (`clip.key`) clears it.

base.description: Only on an `auto` key written over a key set by hand: the level that key was set to, before the dip. Running the command again puts that level back as the hand key and takes the dip from it.

keys.description: Keyframes per property, on the clip's own clock. A keyed property ignores its static value (`transform`, `audio.gain`).

type.description: Clip type registered by an adapter plugin, e.g. `hyperframes`.

in.description: Composition seconds of the first frame. Default 0.

props.description: Adapter-specific properties, validated by the adapter.

x.description: Horizontal move in composition CSS px. Default 0.

y.description: Vertical move in composition CSS px. Default 0.

scale.description: Uniform factor about the element's centre. Default 1.

elements.description: Moves and scales of elements inside the composition, by CSS selector (composition CSS px), applied over the source file. E.g. `{"#title": {"y": -40, "scale": 1.2}}`.

blur.description: Gaussian sigma in project pixels, as CSS `blur()` and ffmpeg `gblur` take it; glass: 46.

saturate.description: Saturation of the blurred backdrop, as CSS `saturate()`: 1 unchanged, 0 grey; glass: 1.45. Default 1.

dim.description: Dark scrim over the blurred backdrop: 0 none, 1 black; glass: 0.55, up to 0.72 over bright footage. Default 0.

backdrop.description: Glass under a generated clip (ADR 0031): the picture below it blurred, saturated and dimmed where the clip's alpha is above about 3 %, then the clip on top; its render is unchanged. Upper video tracks only: on the bottom track nothing is below.

muted.description: True: the track plays no sound in export and preview, whatever its clips' (or angles' and mics') own `audio`. Default false.

hidden.description: True: the track shows no picture in export and preview (the tracks below show through); its sound still plays. Default false.

group.description: Id of the multicam group in the timeline's `groups`; one program track per group.

id.description: Stable, core-generated (`c_…`); reference clips by it.

start.description: Timeline seconds of the first frame.

in.description: Group-clock seconds of the first frame.

out.description: Group-clock seconds just after the last frame; greater than `in`.

shot.description: Layout: `solo` (one angle), `two-up` (two), `grid` (two or more), `screen` (one angle whole), `pip` (screen angle + inset).

angles.description: Angle ids of the track's group, in layout order (left to right, then top to bottom); no repeats. `pip`: the screen first, then the inset.

corner.description: `pip` only: corner of the inset. Default `bottom-right`.

confidence.description: Set by the director: 0 (a guess) to 1 (sure). Absent on shots a person chose.

reason.description: Set by the director: why it chose this shot, in a few words.

scriptRef.description: Script scene this clip realizes: `scripts/<file>.md#<anchor>`; without `#anchor`, the whole script.

take.description: Shoot take this shot was placed from by `shoot.assemble` (a take recorded in the app, ADR 0024).

follows.description: Id of the video or audio track whose clips supply the words.

speakerNames.description: Start the first cue of each speaker turn with the speaker's name (ADR 0020). Default false.

keywordColor.description: Colour of a phrase's keyword (`#rrggbb`); null: the keyword keeps the text colour. Default: the preset's.

keywordScale.description: Keyword size at the start of its entry, as a multiple of its size; it settles to 1. Default: the preset's.

phrases.description: Hand-chunked phrases with their keywords (`captions.set`); words no phrase holds are grouped by the style.

asset.description: Project-relative asset whose transcript holds the words.

words.description: Transcript word ids (`w_…`) in spoken order.

chunks.description: Words per cue, in order; sums to the number of `words`.

keyword.description: Index in `words` of the one emphasised word.

entry.description: Entry of this phrase's cues; default: the track style's.

gaps.description: Ranges in which no cue shows: a cue overlapping one is hidden.

tracks.description: Stacking order: the first video track is the bottom layer.

groups.description: Multicam groups (ADR 0016), each shown by one program track.

id.description: Stable, core-generated (`g_…`); a program track names it in `group`.
Unique within the group; shots name angles by it.

offset.description: Group-clock seconds at which the asset's time 0 plays: source time = group time - offset.

crop.description: Fractions of the source picture (0 to below 1) cut off each side before a shot fills its tile with it.

reframe.description: Where the picture is cut when a tile's aspect differs from it (a solo of a 16:9 camera in a 9:16 export): keys sorted by `at`, the point moving in a straight line between keys and held before the first and after the last; the cut never leaves the cropped picture. Absent: centered. Screens (`screen` shots, a `pip` screen) are never cut.

x.description: Point to center on across the picture: fraction of the source width, 0 left edge, 1 right edge.

y.description: Point to center on down the picture: fraction of the source height, 0 top edge, 1 bottom edge.

audio.description: Gain and mute of the sound of this angle's own file, which plays under every shot. Absent with `mic` set: the mic carries the level.

gain.description: Gain in dB; 0 = unchanged, negative = quieter. Default 0.

mic.description: Where this angle's person is heard. Absent: the sound of its own file. An id of the group's `mics`: that mic (one mic may serve several angles and plays once); the file's own sound is then not played. null: no sound (a wide camera); its own file's sound is not played either.

screen.description: True: a screen share, not a person. The director shows it (`screen`, `pip`) while it moves and never as a speaker. Default false.

speaker.description: Speaker id (`s1`) in the transcript of this angle's sound (its `mic`'s asset, else `asset`) whose words are this person's speaking turns, instead of the energy: for a mic several people share. Angles hearing the same file (or the same mic, once its transcript has speakers) take their turns from speakers anyway; screens never do.

mics.description: Separate sound files of the group; angles pick theirs with `mic`. Absent: every angle has its own file's sound.

id.description: Unique among the group's angles and mics; angles name it in `mic`. Not `camera` or `none`.

asset.description: Project-relative file with sound, e.g. `assets/ana.wav`. Only its sound is used.

offset.description: Group-clock seconds at which the asset's time 0 plays: source time = group time - offset.

audio.description: Gain and mute of this mic's sound, which plays under every shot, once even when several angles use it.

gain.description: Gain in dB; 0 = unchanged, negative = quieter. Default 0.

painted.description: Who speaks, as a person painted it (`multicam.paint`): each stretch replaces the measured turns of its angle on the group clock, for `multicam.turns` and `direct`. Stretches of one angle never overlap. Absent: every turn is measured.

start.description: Group-clock seconds where the stretch starts.

end.description: Group-clock seconds where it ends; greater than `start`.

speaking.description: True: the angle speaks in the stretch. False: it does not, even where its sound is loud.

markers.description: Named points on the timeline clock (ADR 0029), sorted by `at`; labels unique ignoring case. Absent when none.

id.description: Stable, core-generated (`m_…`); reference markers by it or by their label.

at.description: Timeline seconds of the marker, snapped by the core to the frame grid.

label.description: Name, e.g. `hook`; unique in the timeline ignoring case, at most 80 characters, never shaped like an id (`m_1a2b3c`).

color.description: `red`, `orange`, `yellow`, `green`, `blue` or `purple`. Absent: the app's accent colour.

tempo.description: The beat grid the timeline follows (ADR 0029): a music clip's measured grid, or a nominal BPM. Absent: no grid.

clip.description: Media clip whose asset's beat grid (`beats.measure`) the timeline follows, or a nominal grid rides on.

bpm.description: Nominal tempo in beats per minute. Absent: the measured grid of `clip`.

offset.description: Nominal grid only: the first beat, in timeline seconds (with `clip`: in source seconds of the clip). Default 0.

meter.description: Nominal grid only: beats per bar. Default 4.
